components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions such as Delete Item.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--danger, oklch(0.58 0.22 25)); color: var(--text-inverse, oklch(0.98 0 0)); font-family: var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: var(--font-size-md, 0.875rem); font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-hover, oklch(0.5 0.22 25)); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring, oklch(0.72 0.16 75 / 0.2)); }

components.name: Card

components.css: .ds-stack { background: var(--bg-secondary, oklch(0.22 0.008 85)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.32 0.008 85)); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px); padding: var(--spacing-xl, 1.5rem); color: var(--text-primary, oklch(0.95 0.005 85)); } .ds-stack-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Instrument Serif', serif); font-size: var(--font-size-xl, 1.25rem); font-weight: 400; } .ds-stack-figures { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(max-content, 1.5fr) repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: end; gap: 0.75rem 1.25rem; margin: 0; } .ds-stack-figures dt { font-family: var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: var(--font-size-sm, 0.75rem); font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, oklch(0.8 0.008 85)); } .ds-stack-figures dd { margin: 0; } .ds-stack-lead { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 2.5rem; } .ds-stack-value { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-stack-change { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-size: var(--font-size-sm, 0.75rem); color: var(--success-text, oklch(0.72 0.16 155)); }

components.css: .ds-ledger { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--text-primary, oklch(0.95 0.005 85)); } .ds-ledger th { padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.32 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); font-size: var(--font-size-sm, 0.75rem); font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, oklch(0.8 0.008 85)); text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger th:first-child { text-align: left; padding-left: 0; } .ds-ledger td { padding: 0.55rem 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.32 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger td.ds-ledger-name { padding-left: 0; font-family: var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; text-align: left; } .ds-ledger td.ds-ledger-gain { font-weight: 700; color: var(--success-text, oklch(0.72 0.16 155)); } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger :is(tbody, tfoot) tr { cursor: pointer; } .ds-ledger :is(tbody, tfoot) tr:hover td { background: var(--bg-tertiary, oklch(0.28 0.007 85)); } .ds-ledger tfoot td { border-top: 2px solid var(--border, oklch(0.32 0.008 85)); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
StakTrakr is where physical metal gets weighed, tested and recorded. Every surface behaves like an assayer's instrument: it shows the measurement, the reference value and the difference, and it does not decorate them. Screens are dense on purpose. The serious stacker reads many numbers at once and compares them, so tables, tickers and spot cards carry the page.

The material is warm gunmetal lit by gold. Neutrals in the dark theme sit at hue 85 with very low chroma, so greys read as metal rather than as blue screen. The five metal colours and the eleven vendor hues are identification marks, not decoration. Gold is the one accent that carries brand, and it is rationed.

Components are machined and exact: tight radii, crisp 1px borders, flat surfaces separated by tonal steps, and tabular numerals wherever numbers line up. Depth is reserved for layers that sit above the page: modals, popovers and menus.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, scan-first layouts: tables, ticker, spot cards and ledgers are primary surfaces.
Warm gunmetal neutrals with a gold primary in the dark theme.
Metal and vendor colours are fixed identification systems.
Instrument-like controls: flat, bordered, small radii, numerals aligned.
Four themes (dark, light, slate, sepia) with one identity.

rules.name: The Fixed Identity Rule
rules.body: A metal or vendor never changes hue between views or themes. Users learn the mapping, so a remap is a regression.

rules.name: The Rationed Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the brand accent. It marks the primary action, the active state and the wordmark. It does not fill large areas or decorate headings beyond h1.

rules.name: The Function First Rule
rules.body: Every colour on screen identifies a metal or vendor, signals gain, loss or status, or marks the primary action. Colour with no job is removed.

rules.name: The Regular Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif ships at weight 400 only. Never set it bold or synthesise a bold.

rules.name: The Aligned Figures Rule
rules.body: Any column or stack of numbers uses the mono face or tabular numerals, so digits line up for comparison.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Show the data. A surface does not trade visible information for whitespace or hide it behind an extra click.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Surfaces on the page are flat at rest. A shadow appears only for a layer above the page or as a hover response.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: The frosted-glass treatment (backdrop-filter blur on .modal, .modal-content and the image badge overlay) is debt, not identity. New work does not add glass. Surface passes may remove it.

dos: Do author new components against the dark theme first, then check light, slate and sepia.
Do use var(--token) for every colour, size, radius and space. Raw colour literals in js/ fail lint.
Do set prices, weights and quantities in the data face with aligned figures.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or more in all four themes, using the *-text tokens for status words.
donts: Don't add glass blur, neon glows, gradient text or purple-to-blue gradients (crypto and Web3 anti-reference).
Don't use oversized rounded cards or airy startup-dashboard spacing (generic fintech anti-reference).
Don't fall back to a bare grid of numbers with no metal colour, hierarchy or brand (spreadsheet anti-reference).
Don't remap a metal or vendor to a different hue.
Don't use colour as the only signal of state; pair it with a label or icon.
Don't add a fifth theme or reference a contrast theme; there are four.
